failures.title: T1.2.1 — 8-Directional movement: directional input displaces player coordinates by tile increments
failures.classification: MovementSystem integrates velocity continuously; key duration is not a tile count.

failures.title: T1.2.3 — Stamina exhaustion: reaching 0 stamina disables sprint and triggers 4000ms recovery cooldown
failures.classification: Stamina regenerates during the 4000 ms sprint lockout.

failures.title: T1.2.4 — Dash ability: Shift + direction tap triggers rapid 1-tile dash with 1000ms cooldown
failures.classification: Dash lasts 200 ms and cooldown lasts 1000 ms; it is not a discrete tile jump.

failures.title: T1.2.5 — Jump physics: Spacebar executes 5-frame parabolic arc and locks directional inputs during jump
failures.classification: Jump input is steerable; jumpDurationMs controls landing.

failures.title: T1.2.6 — Top-down collision response: solid obstacle tiles block player movement
failures.classification: Player uses a 0.22 x 0.10 half-size offset footbox, not a centred 0.30 box.
